review.notes: Full review. Gate at 18b9874: build passes; imports, mathlib-subimports, no-import-mathlib and metadata fail (R03, R04). Depcheck run: 0 problems but the README has no *Needs:* lines so it contributes no edge. Suggested.lean elaborated on a scratch copy with #check of all 25 declarations and one-tactic probes; all sorried statements true, two (right_inner_action, real_poisson) are one-tactic padding, no headline theorem stated although lattice Poisson summation and the fundamental identity on R^k are statable (R02). Supplier citations resolved at main and the open heads: OperatorAlgebraDynamics D1.CentralTwists/D1.TwistedBorel/D2.CentralTwists exist only in revision PR #1137, not on main, so the twisted group C*-algebras are unowned (R01); NQS M1.ProjectiveExtensions absent at #1015 (R06); HilbertModules #861 H1-H3, VNA #889 V11, NCG N6/N7 main, BanachAlgebras A7 main, AKT #1142 A0/A7, SBR #1145 SB2/SB8 all resolve. Sources fetched and read: Rieffel 1988 (Cambridge Core open PDF) and Austad-Enstad arXiv 1904.10826; the README has no numbered locators, so the sample is the headline statements: 31-row adversarial table recomputing every convention, the four-vector identity, Poisson normalisation, positivity kernel, traces, trace formula and the whole H6 dictionary; no false statement found. Ownership grep over main and open heads found no second owner of the lattice Heisenberg bimodule; GeometryOfNumbers #851 not readable in this brief.
